spans.s: The third letter of the Devanāgarī alphabet.
To go, go to or towards, come to or near; शशिनं पुनरेति शर्वरी

To arrive at, reach, obtain, attain to, go to or be reduced to a particular
 state, fall into; निर्बुद्धिः क्षयमेति

goes to (ruin, is
 ruined; so वशम्, शत्रुत्वम्, शूद्रताम् &c.).
To go away, retire; elapse, pass.
To spring from, come or arise from.
To undertake anything (with acc.); सत्रमायन् Vāj.
To thrive, prosper. ━II. €1 U. = अय् q. v. ━III. €4 Ā.

To ask, request. ━Caus. To cause to go or come. [cf. L. eo;
 Gr. eimi with एमि].
I. €2 P. (In Dhātup. written as इण्) (एति, इयाय, अगात्, एतुम्, इत)
